skill_name: Examine the given issue and explain why it is or isn't an ethical responsibility.
workflow: Yes, companies should strive to help curb climate change. Climate change is an environmental issue that affects all of humanity, and as such all of humanity should be part of the solution. Companies have a moral and ethical responsibility to help protect the environment and reduce their carbon footprint.
